releases.title: Beverly Hills MD Dermal Repair Complex Wins Beauty Product of the Year
releases.body:
The Doctor-Formulated Beauty Product Wins 2026 Mindful Award For its Approach to Supporting Youthful-Looking Skin From the Inside Out

BEVERLY HILLS, Calif., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Beverly Hills MD® Dermal Repair Complex™ has been named Beauty Product of the Year at the 2026 Mindful Awards, recognizing the supplement's science-backed formula and its measurable impact on skin firmness, texture, and overall radiance. The award places Dermal Repair Complex among a small group of products recognized for addressing the internal drivers of visible aging. Unlike topical-only solutions, Dermal Repair Complex works from within to support the key factors behind skin breakdown, including collagen loss and moisture depletion, offering a whole-body approach to smoother, more lifted-looking skin.†* 

What is Beverly Hills MD Dermal Repair Complex

Dermal Repair Complex is Beverly Hills MD's advanced youthful-skin supporting dietary supplement, formulated to help the body combat the internal causes of skin breakdown. Rather than treating aging skin from the outside in, this daily supplement is designed to work systemically to address sagging, fine lines, wrinkles, and dullness at the source. It's intended to complement, not replace, a topical skincare routine, offering users a two-pronged approach to aging skin: targeted surface treatment paired with structural support from within.†*

The supplement comes in capsule form and is designed to fit easily into an existing daily routine, without requiring users to overhaul their existing skincare regimen or habits.

Why Did Beverly Hills MD Dermal Repair Complex Win The 2026 Mindful Award?

The Mindful Awards recognize beauty and wellness products that combine ingredient transparency, formulation integrity, and real-world results. Dermal Repair Complex stood out for its targeted approach to support often-overlooked drivers of skin aging, including collagen breakdown, declining elasticity, and loss of structural support beneath the skin's surface.†*

The formula boasts whole-body benefits, not just facial improvements. These benefits include visible improvements across the neck, chest, arms, and hands, making it a key differentiator from single-purpose topical products.†* 

For Beverly Hills MD, the award adds to a growing list of industry recognitions and reinforces the brand's positioning at the intersection of clinical-grade formulation and consumer-friendly skincare.

Key Ingredients in Beverly Hills MD Dermal Repair Complex

Beverly Hills MD Dermal Repair Complex's formula centers on three core ingredients, each targeting a different aspect of visible skin aging:

  • Hydrolyzed Collagen - A bioavailable form of collagen that supplies the skin with the building blocks it needs to maintain a firm, lifted appearance. As natural collagen production slows with age, supplementing with hydrolyzed collagen is designed to help offset that decline and support the skin's underlying structure.†*
  • Saw Palmetto - Included in the formula to help reinforce skin's natural elasticity and support a more youthful-looking structure over time.†*
  • MSM (Methylsulfonylmethane) - A naturally occurring mineral compound, MSM supports a youthful skin structure from within, contributing to a firmer, more toned look as part of the formula's overall approach to dermal support.†*

The formula is made without gelatin, fish/shellfish, caffeine, dairy, soy, or nuts, making it accessible to a wide range of dietary needs and sensitivities, a detail the brand highlights as part of its broader formulation transparency.

What are the Benefits of Beverly Hills MD Dermal Repair Complex

Dermal Repair Complex is built around three primary, visible outcomes:

  • Lifting - Helps skin all over the body appear more taut, particularly in areas where sagging tends to show first.†*
  • Smoothing - Visibly reduces the appearance of wrinkles, including crow's feet, forehead creases, pucker lines, and fine lines.†*
  • Plumping - Renews plumpness in thin, crepey-looking skin, an effect often associated with age-related moisture and collagen loss.†*

Beyond skin, users may also notice youth-enhancing bonus benefits, including thicker-looking hair and stronger nails. This reflects the formula's systemic approach, as many of the same nutrients that support skin structure also support hair and nail health.†*

What Does Beverly Hills MD Dermal Repair Complex Target?

The formula is designed to address three of the most common visible signs of aging:

  • Aging skin across the body, not just the face, including the neck, chest, arms, hands, and legs†*
  • Wrinkles, ranging from fine lines to deeper, more established creases†*
  • Sagging, particularly in areas prone to visible aging like the jowls, neck, jawline, cheeks, and chin†*

By targeting these three concerns simultaneously, rather than treating them as separate issues, the formula is designed to support a more comprehensive anti-aging routine.

How to Use Beverly Hills MD Dermal Repair Complex

For best results, take 2 capsules of Beverly Hills MD Dermal Repair Complex daily with 8 fl. oz. of water and a meal, or as directed by a healthcare provider. Consistency is key with any dietary supplement, and Beverly Hills MD recommends incorporating Dermal Repair Complex into a daily routine for sustained results.

Dermal Repair Complex is also designed to complement an existing skincare routine rather than replace it. Beverly Hills MD recommends continuing regular use of favorite cleansers, serums, moisturizers, and masks alongside the supplement, pairing internal support with targeted topical treatment for a more complete approach to aging skin.

Who is Beverly Hills MD Dermal Repair Complex Formulated For?

Beverly Hills MD Dermal Repair Complex is designed for anyone noticing the early or ongoing signs of skin aging, including sagging, fine lines, wrinkles, and a loss of firmness, anywhere on the body. Because the formula works systemically rather than targeting a single area, it's positioned as a whole-body approach to aging skin, rather than a spot-treatment solution.†*

Beverly Hills MD Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What exactly is Dermal Repair Complex?

Dermal Repair Complex is Beverly Hills MD's advanced anti-aging dietary supplement, specifically formulated to fight common causes of visible aging. It's designed to help the body combat sagging, fine lines, wrinkles, and dullness that come with the aging process.†*

How is Dermal Repair Complex different from a topical anti-aging product?

Rather than working only on the surface of the skin, Dermal Repair Complex is designed to be taken daily as a supplement, targeting the internal causes of visible aging, including collagen loss and moisture depletion, from within. It's designed to be used alongside, not instead of, a topical skincare routine.†*

Can I take this with hormone replacement therapy that my doctor has prescribed?

We highly recommend consulting with your physician before combining any new supplement with an existing medication regimen.

I'm concerned about aging skin on my body, not just my face. Can Dermal Repair Complex help with that?

Yes. Because Dermal Repair Complex works from the inside out, it can help renew and rejuvenate skin throughout the body, not just the face. Alongside a smoother, more youthful facial appearance, users can also expect results on the neck, chest, arms, hands, legs, and anywhere else visible aging has appeared over the years.†*

Does Dermal Repair Complex contain any common allergens?

No. The formula is made without gelatin, fish/shellfish, caffeine, dairy, soy, or nuts.

How long does it take to see results?

Results can vary from person to person, and consistent daily use is recommended for the best outcome. As with most dietary supplements, visible changes to skin firmness and texture typically build over time rather than overnight.

What happens if it's not for me?

Beverly Hills MD is confident you'll love the benefits you achieve with Dermal Repair Complex. However, if you decide this formula isn't right for you, for any reason, our extended 90-Day Money Back Guarantee has you covered. Just send the bottles you wish to return to them, even if they're empty, and they'll refund your purchase price in full right away (minus shipping). It's important to them that you feel confident and comfortable when you're trying something new.

About Beverly Hills MD

Beverly Hills MD was created by Dr. John Layke and Dr. Payman Danielpour of the innovative Beverly Hills Plastic Surgery Group. With their cutting-edge Beverly Hills MD skincare line, the celebrity-favorite surgeons reach beyond their office walls, offering at-home "look younger" results for those seeking the best available at-home solutions. Each product works to visibly correct the most stubborn skincare concerns. Other Beverly Hills MD beauty supplement bestsellers include Plump + Firm Advanced Collagen Booster, ElastaBoost, and Beauty Sweet. For the latest news, follow Beverly Hills MD on Instagram @officialbhmd and YouTube.

About Dr. John Layke and Dr. Payman Danielpour

Cosmetic surgeons to the stars, Dr. John Layke and Dr. Payman Danielpour are renowned plastic surgeons and co-founders of the Beverly Hills Plastic Surgery Group. Both doctors were trained at the prestigious Long Island Plastic Surgical Group before offering world-class procedures at their Beverly Hills clinic. In 2014, their passion for science inspired them to develop advanced ingredient formulations to help users achieve visible results at home — and the Beverly Hills MD skincare line was born.

Expanding their vision of total rejuvenation, the duo also founded Proactive Longevity in Cabo San Lucas — one of the few clinics in Mexico to hold a Regenerative Medicine License. Continuing their commitment to innovation and beauty, Dr. Layke and Dr. Danielpour debuted their first med spa, Glossy Skin Lounge, in Newport Beach, CA, offering a luxury experience that unites cutting-edge aesthetic procedures with holistic longevity care. For more, follow them on Instagram @plastixdocs, and TikTok.

releases.title: PROJECT HEALTHY MINDS AND HARVARD BUSINESS SCHOOL RESEARCHERS TO EXPAND THE EVIDENCE BASE AROUND WORKFORCE MENTAL HEALTH
releases.body:
'Project Healthy Minds Workforce Lab' brings together leading companies to create a standardized measurement framework and build the business case for workforce mental health

NEW YORK, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Project Healthy Minds, the leading mental health tech nonprofit dedicated to expanding access to mental health services across the United States, today announced the formation of the Project Healthy Minds Workforce Lab, a groundbreaking coalition bringing together blue-chip companies, leading scholars and top thought leaders to expand the evidence base of "what works" for workforce mental health. A first-of-its-kind research hub for employers, the Lab will generate new evidence at the intersection of business, economics, and public health — helping companies build stronger, more resilient workforces and healthier organizations.

Project Healthy Minds is the mental health tech nonprofit dedicated to expanding access to mental health services.

Founding members of the Project Healthy Minds Workforce Lab are Acast, Apollo Global Management, AXIS Capital, KPMG, L'Oréal USA, ServiceNow, TD SYNNEX, Teneo and Universal Music Group. The Lab is co-chaired by Jacqui Canney, Chief People and AI Enablement Officer of ServiceNow, and Stephanie Kramer, Chief Human Resources Officer of L'Oréal North America. Ryan W. Buell, CD Spangler Professor of Business Administration at Harvard Business School serves as an academic collaborator with the Coalition, helping to shape a research agenda designed to engage scholars and employers in generating rigorous evidence on what works in workforce mental health.

For decades, workforce mental health has been treated as a benefits-and-wellness conversation. Meanwhile, the World Health Organization estimates 12 billion working days are lost annually to depression and anxiety alone, costing roughly $1 trillion in lost productivity globally; and in 2024, diminished employee productivity drained an additional $438 billion worldwide, according to Gallup. Yet no standardized framework exists to measure what interventions are actually working.

The Lab reframes mental health as an operational and financial performance question — building a blueprint for how companies can support, measure, and ultimately improve mental health in the workplace, with a focus on the sustained productivity of a retained, engaged, healthy workforce in a dynamic business context. Across Project Healthy Minds' owned thought leadership and flagship business and cultural convenings, Lab Member executives will foster dialogue on the current state and future of employee wellbeing.

"For too long, the conversation about workforce mental health has lived in the wellness aisle. The Project Healthy Minds Workforce Lab founding members are saying something different — that mental health is a performance issue, a retention issue, and an issue leadership must key in on. We're proud to be working with a group of outstanding companies, alongside researchers from Harvard Business School, to build the evidence that proves it, and a playbook every employer can use," said Phillip Schermer, Founder & CEO of Project Healthy Minds.

"At ServiceNow, we believe the companies that outperform and outlast will be the ones that prioritize their people. Wellbeing is the foundation that sustains the judgment, creativity, and resilience organizations depend on, especially amid rapid transformation. The Project Healthy Minds Workforce Lab brings together leading CHROs and researchers at Harvard Business School to measure what actually works. We're proud to be part of this effort," said Canney.

"Prioritizing mental health is a fundamental leadership responsibility and essential for sustainable performance. At L'Oréal, we believe that a company is not walls and machines, it's people, people, people," said Kramer, "Through partnerships like the Project Healthy Minds Workforce Lab, we are proud to elevate this dialogue, learn from data-driven research with Harvard Business School experts, and share best practices that create a ripple of positive change far beyond our own walls."

"The most substantive progress happens when leading organizations are willing to study themselves — and each other — with intellectual honesty, " said Buell. "That's what this coalition strives to do. It has an opportunity to generate an evidence base that will allow more employers to move from good intentions to proven practice."

The Project Healthy Minds Workforce Lab is designed as a long-term, year-over-year research endeavor, with continuous publications and ongoing findings released as the work progresses. Each member company will receive a private readout including peer benchmarking, custom recommendations, an ROI analysis, and an action plan — alongside the aggregated findings shared with the field.

Member company employees will also benefit directly through turnkey engagement campaigns, employee volunteering opportunities, and access to Project Healthy Minds' annual World Mental Health Day Festival in New York City.

The Lab will anchor its programming around two flagship moments each year: World Mental Health Day on October 10 with Project Healthy Minds' signature Festival in New York City and Mental Health Awareness Month in May. 

ABOUT PROJECT HEALTHY MINDS:

Project Healthy Minds is a Millennial & Gen Z-driven mental health tech nonprofit dedicated to expanding access to mental health services across the United States for every community. Project Healthy Minds focuses on three programmatic areas: (1) destigmatizing mental health by mobilizing culture-makers; (2) expanding access to mental health services through the world's first free digital mental health marketplace; and (3) advocating for innovative workplace investments in employee mental health. Project Healthy Minds' programmatic initiatives have served more than 500,000 people. For more information, visit www.projecthealthyminds.com.

releases.title: Prime Minister Carney launches Digital Transformation Canada to deliver better, faster, more reliable government services to Canadians
releases.body:
OTTAWA, ON, Sept. 3, 2026 /CNW/ -- Canada must be more productive, competitive, and resilient to succeed in a rapidly changing world. Achieving that goal requires a government equipped with the tools and capabilities needed to deliver better results for Canadians – through services that are faster, more secure, and reliable.

Earlier this year, the government launched AI for All, Canada's national AI strategy, to harness the transformative potential of artificial intelligence (AI) to improve services, boost productivity, and strengthen Canada's economy. The strategy commits the federal government to lead by example in the responsible adoption of AI and to use government procurement as a strategic anchor customer for Canadian AI companies, helping them scale, strengthening domestic capacity, and reinforcing Canada's digital sovereignty.

Today, the Prime Minister, Mark Carney, announced the launch of Digital Transformation Canada, a new federal organisation with a clear mission: to use digital solutions to make it easier for Canadians to access the support and services they need from government.

The Prime Minister is also pleased to announce the appointment of Patrick Pichette to spearhead this mission as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Digital Transformation Canada.

Mr. Pichette is a distinguished Canadian business leader with more than 30 years of experience in finance, technology, and corporate leadership. As Chief Financial Officer of Google from 2008 to 2015, he helped guide the company through a period of significant global growth and transformation. A Rhodes Scholar and former senior executive at Bell Canada, McKinsey, and Sprint Canada, he is internationally recognised for his expertise in innovation, digital transformation, and building high-performing organisations.

Under the responsibility of the Minister of Government Transformation, Public Works and Procurement, Joël Lightbound, Digital Transformation Canada will bring together Shared Services Canada and selected functions from the Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat, Public Services and Procurement Canada, and Employment and Social Development Canada – specifically the Canadian Digital Service.

By combining digital expertise and delivery capacity from across government, the organisation will improve how government develops, buys, and uses technology. Its priorities will be to:

  • Scale shared solutions across government to reduce duplication and operating costs, making better use of emerging technologies such as AI, strengthening Canada's digital sovereignty and security, and improving Canadians' experience with federal services.
  • Equip public servants with more modern, secure tools to reduce administrative burden, improve efficiency, and help departments focus on delivering their core programs and services.
  • Use the Government of Canada's purchasing power more strategically to help Canadian digital and AI companies test, scale, and commercialise new technologies – creating opportunities for Canadian firms to grow at home and compete globally.

To support its mandate, Digital Transformation Canada will also establish a fellowship model to bring specialised private-sector expertise into government for short-term assignments, including in advanced AI and other fast-moving digital fields. This model will focus on knowledge transfer – helping build the public service's own technical capacity, commercial expertise, and ability to evaluate, procure, and deploy new technologies responsibly.

Launching Digital Transformation Canada builds on the government's commitment to make the public service more productive and results-focused. By testing and scaling solutions that work, reducing duplication, and backing Canadian innovation, we will deliver better value for taxpayers and better services for Canadians, while helping Canadian technology companies grow at home and compete globally.

Quotes

"Canada's future prosperity will be built by those who innovate, adopt new technologies, and move quickly to seize new opportunities. Digital Transformation Canada will ensure the federal government leads by example. By modernising public service delivery, reducing duplication, and supporting the growth of Canadian technology firms, we will strengthen our economy, improve outcomes for Canadians, and position Canada to lead in the digital age. The addition of Patrick Pichette will bring world-class expertise in digital transformation, innovation, and organisational change to help advance this crucial work."

-- The Rt. Hon. Mark Carney, Prime Minister of Canada

"Digital Transformation Canada marks a new chapter in how government delivers results for Canadians. By embracing digital innovation, investing in people, and leveraging Canada's world-class AI ecosystem, we will improve services, strengthen digital sovereignty, and create new opportunities for Canadian companies to grow and compete globally. Our goal is clear: bring together the country's brightest technologists to work with the public service to build a stronger, more effective federal government."

-- The Hon. Joël Lightbound, Minister of Government Transformation, Public Works and Procurement and Québec Lieutenant

releases.title: Renowned Systems Safety Expert Professor Najmedin Meshkati, PhD, Appointed to ECRI Board of Trustees
releases.body:
Aviation, nuclear, and industrial accident investigator brings decades of complex-systems safety expertise to healthcare's leading independent patient safety authority

FORT WASHINGTON, Pa., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ECRI, a global authority on healthcare safety and quality, announced the appointment of Professor Najmedin Meshkati, PhD, to its Board of Trustees. For nearly four decades, Professor Meshkati's research has focused on reducing risk and improving reliability in complex, high-consequence systems, including nuclear power, aviation, and petrochemical operations.

Professor Meshkati has investigated some of the most closely studied system failures of the past 30 years, including the BP Texas City Refinery explosion, the Deepwater Horizon oil spill, and the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear disaster. He testified before the U.S. Senate Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation as a member of the FAA's independent Expert Panel on Boeing examining safety management system and safety culture at Boeing. He is a member and presently chairs the State of California's Diablo Canyon Independent Safety Committee.

Professor Meshkati served as a Commissioner of The Joint Commission from 2016 to 2024; currently serves on the Governance Board of the Patient Safety Movement Foundation; has been a member of Quality Committee of the Hospital Governing Boards of the University of Southern California; and is active in the World Health Organization and Imperial College of London Global Patient Safety Collaborative. He is an elected Fellow and inaugural "Titan" of the Human Factors and Ergonomics Society. Professor Meshkati is a tenured professor at the University of Southern California, holding appointments in Civil and Environmental Engineering, Industrial and Systems Engineering, and International Relations.

"Professor Meshkati has spent his career studying why complex systems fail and what it takes to make them consistently safer. That is precisely the lens ECRI applies to healthcare," said Marcus Schabacker, MD, PhD, President and CEO, ECRI. "His appointment on our Board of Trustees strengthens our ability to help hospitals and health systems proactively design safer care. In high-risk industries like aviation and nuclear power, companies with reliably safe outcomes view safety from a system-lens, rooted in human factors engineering and a safety culture. Relying on individual vigilance to avoid accidents is shortsighted and dangerous, yet it happens in healthcare every day."

Professor Meshkati's board appointment comes as ECRI deepens its focus on SafeSystem Solutions, powered by human factors engineering and a safety-focused culture for the workforce, central to ECRI's approach to reducing preventable harm. ECRI's services are focused on creating resilient and safe healthcare systems and assessing technologies used in those systems, backed by new investments and a commitment to transformative change. 

"Patient harm rarely stems from a single incident; it is often the result of a causal chain shaped by the culture, systems, technology and human factors in the care environment," added Schabacker. "Healthcare must move beyond looking at safety failures in isolation to better understand the conditions that allow harm to occur. Professor Meshkati brings critical systems-thinking expertise to ECRI that will help us scale a more holistic approach to safety."

About ECRI

ECRI is an independent, nonprofit organization improving the safety, quality, and cost-effectiveness of care across all healthcare settings. Over the past six decades, ECRI has built its reputation on integrity and disciplined rigor, with an unwavering commitment to independence and evidence-based insights. ECRI is designated an Evidence-based Practice Center by the U.S. Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality. The ECRI and Institute for Safe Medication Practices PSO is a federally certified Patient Safety Organization (PSO) as designated by the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. ECRI is the only organization worldwide to conduct independent medical device evaluations. ECRI acquired The Institute for Safe Medication Practices (ISMP) in 2020 to address one of the most prolific causes of preventable harm in healthcare, medication errors; then acquired The Just Culture Company in 2024 to transform healthcare workplace cultures – thus creating one of the largest healthcare quality and safety entities in the world.

releases.title: Pickleman's Adds Industry Veteran Jim Morey to Executive Advisory Board to Accelerate Scalable Growth
releases.body:
Former Wawa EVP/CMO, Outback Steakhouse VP–Finance, and McDonald's Senior Financial Director Joins Pickleman's Executive Team

COLUMBIA, Mo., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Pickleman's Gourmet Café today announced that Jim Morey has joined the company's executive advisory board, bringing deep multi-unit operating, finance, and brand experience from Wawa, Inc., Outback Steakhouse (Bloomin' Brands), and McDonald's to support the brand's next phase of disciplined expansion.

"I think this brand can catch fire; it's got everything it needs."

Morey spent more than a decade at Wawa, Inc. in senior roles including Executive Vice President & Chief Marketing/Brand Officer, Chief Operating Officer, and Chief Financial Officer—overseeing brand, marketing, IT, store operations, real estate, supply chain, and enterprise strategy. Earlier, he served as VP–Finance at Outback Steakhouse and Senior Financial Director at McDonald's. He holds an MBA (Marketing & Strategy) from Northwestern University's Kellogg School of Management and a B.S. in Accounting from Illinois State University.

"It's about bringing out the best in everyone. As I look at this brand strategically, I can see the path forward. I think this brand can catch fire; it's got everything it needs," Morey said.

Morey emphasized what he views as the non-negotiable: unit-level economics. "If the individual store works and provides strong returns for the operator, everything else flows from that. That's what Doug and the Pickleman's team are building here. The products have integrity—better-for-you quality—and when executed according to plan, the unit economics work. That combination is where the magic happens. It's time to grow—10, 20, 30+ stores a year over the next few years—and earn our share of the market."

For prospective franchisees, Morey underscored Pickleman's operating blueprint: "You're owning your business without reinventing the wheel. Doug has a nuts-and-bolts playbook. If you're attentive, hands-on, and build the right culture and leadership, existing franchisees have proven success."

Pickleman's Founder & CEO Doug Stritzel welcomed the appointment:

 "Jim's done the job at scale—finance, ops, and brand—and he's laser-focused on store-level returns. His proven experience turning organizations into legacy brands is truly some of the best in the world.This is exactly the kind of operator-first mindset we want guiding our next stage. We're fired up to have him on the team."

Founded in 2005 in Columbia, Missouri, Pickleman's has grown to 30+ locations across Missouri, Kansas, Arkansas, Oklahoma, Indiana, Nebraska, and Texas, built on a commitment to fresh, responsibly sourced ingredients and consistent unit economics. (Pickleman's Gourmet Cafe)

About Jim Morey

  • Wawa, Inc.: EVP & Chief Marketing/Brand Officer; previously COO and CFO. Responsibilities spanned marketing/IT, operations, real estate, supply chain, and enterprise strategy. 
  • Outback Steakhouse (Bloomin' Brands): VP–Finance

  • Education: MBA, Northwestern University—Kellogg (Marketing & Strategy); B.S., Accounting, Illinois State University.

Pickleman's is a fast-casual concept known for fresh, better-for-you sandwiches, soups, salads, and pizzas. Established in 2005 and headquartered in Columbia, Missouri, the brand continues to expand across the Midwest and South. (Pickleman's Gourmet Cafe)

releases.body:
Business leaders, chambers of commerce, corporate executives and policymakers from across the country will convene September 14–16 to advance opportunity, innovation, and America's economic growth

WASHINGTON, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The United States Hispanic Chamber of Commerce (USHCC) will bring the nation's most influential business leaders, chamber leaders, corporate executives, policymakers and Hispanic Chamber leaders to Fort Worth, Texas, September 14–16 for the 47th Annual USHCC National Conference taking place at the Fort Worth Convention Center.

This year's theme is "Unstoppable: Achieving Success and Powering America's Growth." The USHCC conference will convene business leaders from across the country for three days of high-level conversations, ranging from AI, to business development, procurement opportunities in infrastructure and transportation, a women's luncheon, awards gala and networking focused on strengthening Hispanic enterprise and the broader American economy.

The key stakeholders and special speakers taking the stage will be:

  • Jackie Puente, Vice President External Affairs, Comcast Corporation
  • Victor Arias, CEO, Encantado Advisors
  • Ambassador Ken Salazar, former U.S. Secretary of the Interior, former U.S. Senator and former U.S. Ambassador to Mexico

  • Luana Lopes Lara, Co-Founder and COO of Kalshi

  • Bret Perkins, Senior Vice President of External and Government Affairs, Comcast Corporation
  • Allen Nye, CEO of Oncor
  • Nat Pieper, Chief Commercial Officer of American Airlines
  • Ramiro A. Cavazos, President & CEO, United States Hispanic Chamber of Commerce

The conference will also feature leading companies shaping business and culture, including:

  • Comcast Corporation
  • PNC
  • Spectrum Reach
  • JPMC
  • Huntington Bank
  • Thrivent
  • Visa

"Fort Worth is the perfect backdrop for this year's theme, 'Unstoppable,' because the city captures exactly what Hispanic entrepreneurs bring to the American economy – tenacity, ingenuity and an unrelenting drive to grow," said Ramiro A. Cavazos, President & CEO, USHCC. "We'll bring together the policymakers, corporate leaders and business owners who are shaping the future of access to capital, capacity building, and contracts across the country."

Exclusive announcements and new data shaping the Hispanic business landscape from:

  • MetLife
  • Latino Donor Collaborative
  • Airbnb
  • Spectrum Reach
  • Wells Fargo

Celebrating Excellence in Hispanic Business

The conference will culminate with the USHCC Awards Gala on September 16, honoring businesses, corporations and Hispanic Chambers whose leadership is creating measurable economic and community impact.

The USHCC will recognize its 2026 honorees, including:

  • Corporation of the Year: Tony Jimenez, President, CEO & Fouder, MicroTech
  • Small Business Person of the Year: Javier Diaz, CEO, OSI Engineering
  • Chamber of the Year – Small: Brazoria County Hispanic Chamber of Commerce
  • Chamber of the Year – Medium: West Michigan Hispanic Chamber of Commerce
  • Chamber of the Year – Large: Hispanic Chamber of Commerce of Louisiana
  • ERG Winner – Oscar Health
  • Ohtli Award – Rosa Navejar, President & CEO, The Rios Group

"Our National Conference is where the small business community comes together not just to network, but to build the partnerships and pipelines that translate directly into jobs, contracts and economic prosperity," said Jackie Puente, USHCC Board Chairwoman. "This year's agenda highlights the opportunities our members tell us matter most, and I'm proud that Fort Worth will host the leaders who are putting those ideas into action."

The 47th Annual USHCC National Conference takes place September 14–16, 2026, in Fort Worth, Texas.

Members of the media interested in covering the conference or requesting interviews with USHCC leadership, speakers, award recipients or participating business leaders may contact Tatiana Peralta at tperalta@ushcc.com.

About the United States Hispanic Chamber of Commerce (USHCC)

The United States Hispanic Chamber of Commerce is America's largest small business advocacy group, representing over 260 local chambers and business associations nationwide and partners with hundreds of major American corporations. Annually, more than $4.4 trillion GDP is contributed by U.S. Latinos, forming a vital economic force. The USHCC is dedicated to supporting 70 million Latinos nationwide. The USHCC actively promotes the economic growth, development, and interests of more than five million Hispanic-owned businesses.

TORONTO, Sept. 3, 2026 /CNW/ -- TD Bank Group ("TD" or the "Bank") today announced senior leadership appointments to strengthen key capabilities and further accelerate execution.

"We have significant momentum and even greater opportunity ahead as we drive change, power our businesses with AI, and deliver differentiated, more human, client experiences. These appointments bring critical capabilities together, strengthen accountability, and position us to move faster on the priorities that will define TD's next chapter of success," said Raymond Chun, Group President and Chief Executive Officer, TD Bank Group.

The following appointments are effective September 4, 2026.

Vlad Shpilsky is appointed Group Head, Global Technology and Solutions (GTS) and will continue to lead the GTS organization, advancing TD's technology and digital leadership across the Bank. Under his leadership, the Bank has deployed new innovations and platforms and launched new AI-enabled applications to accelerate internal operations, enhance resilience and security, elevate the client experience, and drive growth across all lines of business. 

Renu Gupta is appointed Senior Executive Vice President and Chief Strategy and Commercial Officer and will join the Senior Executive Team. The role brings together key capabilities to help accelerate strategy, growth and execution, including Enterprise Strategy, Corporate Development, Digital Assets, Payments, Partnerships and Procurement. Gupta joined TD in 2020 after a successful career in investment banking and is currently EVP, Corporate Development and Chief Financial Officer of TD Securities.

Paul Whitehead is appointed Senior Executive Vice President, Global Corporate Services and will join the Senior Executive Team. In addition to his existing mandate, overseeing global client and colleague experience, transformation, enterprise real estate and marketing, Whitehead will assume responsibility for Global Corporate Affairs and enterprise AI. Bringing these capabilities together will help further strengthen alignment and accelerate execution across the Bank. Whitehead is a career TD banker with a track record of successful leadership across many of TD's lines of business and corporate functions.

With these changes, Taylan Turan, Group Head, Chief Operating Officer, will leave TD. Since joining the Bank, Turan has helped advance and accelerate TD's transformation agenda, strengthening how we operate, extending our AI leadership, and building capabilities that will support future growth.

"I want to thank Taylan for his partnership and leadership and wish him the very best for the future," added Chun.

About TD Bank Group

The Toronto-Dominion Bank and its subsidiaries are collectively known as TD Bank Group ("TD" or the "Bank"). TD is the sixth largest bank in North America by assets and serves 28.2 million clients in four key businesses operating in a number of locations in financial centres around the globe: Canadian Personal and Commercial Banking, including TD Canada Trust and TD Auto Finance Canada; U.S. Banking, including TD Auto Finance U.S. and TD Wealth (U.S.); Wealth Management and Insurance, including TD Wealth (Canada), TD Direct Investing and TD Insurance; and Wholesale Banking, including TD Securities and TD Cowen. TD also ranks among North America's leading digital banks, with more than 14 million active mobile users in Canada and the U.S. TD had $2.1 trillion in assets on July 31, 2026. The Toronto-Dominion Bank trades under the symbol "TD" on the Toronto Stock Exchange and New York Stock Exchange.

BURBANK, Calif., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- CJ 4DPLEX, the world's leading producer of premium cinema formats and immersive theater experiences, and B&B Theatres, the fifth-largest theatre chain in America, announced today the opening of a new 4DX auditorium and SCREENX auditorium enhanced by Dolby Atmos at B&B Theatres Liberty Township in Butler County, Ohio.
releases.title: CJ 4DPLEX and B&B Theatres Strengthen Partnership with New 4DX and SCREENX Experiences at Liberty Township, Ohio
releases.body:
Newly opened Ohio expansion features B&B's first multisensory 4DX auditorium in the state, Ohio's largest SCREENX 270-degree panoramic auditorium, and North America's first SCREENX with Dolby Atmos

BURBANK, Calif., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- CJ 4DPLEX, the world's leading producer of premium cinema formats and immersive theater experiences, and B&B Theatres, the fifth-largest theatre chain in America, announced today the opening of a new 4DX auditorium and SCREENX auditorium enhanced by Dolby Atmos at B&B Theatres Liberty Township in Butler County, Ohio.

The new experiences, which opened to moviegoers last Friday, represent several meaningful milestones for CJ 4DPLEX. SCREENX arrives in the Cincinnati market for the first time, becoming the fifth installation in Ohio and the fifteenth across B&B Theatres' growing portfolio of premium cinematic experiences. Situated within B&B's Grand Screen PLF auditorium, the 270-degree format expands across a sweeping 57-foot-wide screen with 198 recliner seats, making it the largest SCREENX auditorium in Ohio and one of the most striking SCREENX cinematic spaces in the country.

The 98-seat 4DX auditorium is equally significant, marking the multisensory format's debut in Ohio and the second developed alongside B&B Theatres. Together, the two formats under one roof represent the latest milestone in CJ 4DPLEX and B&B Theatres' expanding partnership and shared commitment to elevating the moviegoing experience.

SCREENX introduces a 270-degree panoramic viewing environment that expands select scenes of a film beyond the main screen and onto the auditorium's side walls, surrounding audiences and placing them directly inside the story. At Liberty Township, that visual immersion is matched by the power of Dolby Atmos, a revolutionary spatial audio technology that moves beyond the traditional surround sound experience.

4DX takes the experience a step further by synchronizing motion seats and environmental effects, including wind, vibration, lightning, scent and water, with the action on screen, allowing audiences to feel the film as it unfolds.

"Our relationship with B&B Theatres continues to reach new heights, and the Liberty Township location is a testament to what we can accomplish together," said Don Savant, CEO and President, Americas at CJ 4DPLEX. "Every new opening reflects our shared vision of expanding premium cinema experiences, and bringing the first SCREENX with Dolby Atmos in the United States to this market is another exciting milestone."

"SCREENX and 4DX represent the spirit of innovation that has guided B&B for over a hundred years," said Brock Bagby, President of B&B Theatres. "We are committed to creating venues that feature the best entertainment in the marketplace, and CJ 4DPLEX has been an incredible partner in the realization of that vision. We are thrilled to bring these experiences to Liberty Township."

CJ 4DPLEX and B&B Theatres first joined forces in 2018, and their premium cinema footprint has grown steadily ever since. Liberty Township is their fourteenth SCREENX and second 4DX location together and reinforces both companies' long-term commitment to growing premium cinema together.

Home to Ohio's largest SCREENX auditorium and North America's first SCREENX with Dolby Atmos, alongside Ohio's first 4DX theater, B&B Theatres Liberty Township is located at 7514 Bales St., Liberty Township, OH 45069. Both experiences are now open to moviegoers. Tickets can be purchased at bbtheatres.com.

About CJ 4DPLEX

CJ 4DPLEX is a proud subsidiary of CJ Group, Korea's leading lifestyle and culture company. Headquartered in Sangam, Seoul, we design and develop immersive cinema technologies that inspire audiences worldwide. Guided by creativity, technology and cultural vision, we are committed to redefining the future of cinema starting right here in Korea.

CJ 4DPLEX is redefining the moviegoing experience across many countries worldwide, working with the world's top exhibitors to deliver SCREENX, 4DX and ULTRA 4DX to audiences everywhere. From the United States to Europe, Asia and the Middle East, our global presence keeps growing, driven by our mission to make immersive storytelling the standard in cinema. Innovation drives us to connect people beyond language and borders through shared experiences.

CJ 4DPLEX can be found at www.cj4dplex.com.

About 4DX

4DX provides a synesthetic viewing experience that connects audiences with movies through its state-of-the-art motion seats and 21 environmental effects that include water, wind and scents. The 4DX theater allows audiences to experience environmental effects such as wind, light, fog, fragrance and vibration, as well as motion chairs that move in synchronization with scenes in the movie. Audiences can experience a new level of immersion that extends beyond traditional video and sound.

About SCREENX

SCREENX is the world's most immersive platform, breaking free from the boundaries of a single screen to place audiences at the heart of the story.

With visuals flowing seamlessly across the walls, SCREENX connects film and space, creating moments of natural immersion. Every sequence is curated to reflect the director's vision, turning each film into a journey only SCREENX can deliver.

About B&B Theatres

B&B Theatres has been family owned and operated since 1924, when Elmer Bills Sr. opened a movie house in Salisbury, Missouri, where the future Mrs. Bills played the piano for silent movies. Across more than a century and four generations of family involvement, the company has seen the arrival of sound, color, Technicolor, stadium seating, multiplexes, recliners and digital cinema. B&B Theatres is the fifth-largest theatre chain in America and operates approximately 517 screens at 54 locations across the United States.

Founded in 1983, OCC is headquartered in Roanoke, Virginia with offices, manufacturing and warehouse facilities located in Roanoke, Virginia, near Asheville, North Carolina and near Dallas, Texas. OCC's facilities are ISO 9001:2015 registered and its Dallas facility is also MIL-STD-790G certified.

releases.title: Created in LA Announces New Speakers and Programming Details Featuring Dhar Mann, Dude Perfect, The Try Guys, Asad Ayaz, Jared Bush and More as Sticks Makes History at El Capitan Theatre
releases.body:
Disney CEO Josh D'Amaro to welcome creators to the Walt Disney Studios lot; President and Chief Creative Officer Dana Walden to deliver opening night remarks

BURBANK, Calif., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Today, Disney and creator Jon Youshaei announced additional speakers for Created in LA, adding Dude Perfect, The Try Guys, Jordan Matter, Adrian Per, Dhar Mann, and Oscar-winning Chief Creative Officer of Walt Disney Animation Studios Jared Bush to the lineup. The announcement also includes new programming details for Chief Marketing and Brand Officer of The Walt Disney Company Asad Ayaz. They join previously announced speakers including Zach King, AdamW, Jenny Hoyos and Sam Eckholm.

Created in LA will open on September 17 with a red-carpet premiere highlighted by the debut of an original video from Sticks on the El Capitan Theatre's big screen. Titled "The Technoblade Movie," the project serves as a tribute to one of the most beloved creators. Sticks is a filmmaking and digital creator duo with 1.2M in social reach that has emerged as a rising voice in the next generation of creator-led entertainment. The screening marks the first time in the theater's 100-year history that it will host a premiere of this kind.

Dana Walden, President and Chief Creative Officer of The Walt Disney Company, will kick off the creator premiere at the El Capitan Theatre on September 17. On September 18, Chief Executive Officer of The Walt Disney Company, Josh D'Amaro, will take the stage at the Walt Disney Studios lot, gathering storytellers at the place where Walt Disney's vision of creativity and innovation all started.

New Speakers and Session Details

Adrian Per | Outsmart the Algorithm: More Content, Less Burnout

As one of Instagram's Top 25 creators in 2025, Adrian Per has been praised by Instagram CEO Adam Mosseri as "one of the most influential creators on the platform." In this talk presented by Adobe, Adrian gives a masterclass on his creative process, how to be original, and increase your quantity of posts without losing quality or burning out.

Asad Ayaz | Your Next Big Project with Disney

Most creators have bigger ambitions than their next upload. They want to direct a feature, star in a series, build a world that outlives the channel. Asad Ayaz, Chief Marketing and Brand Officer of The Walt Disney Company, will show the real paths creators are taking into Disney right now — scripted series, features, brand campaigns — and how creators can take their content to another level with Disney, too.

Dhar Mann | From Script to Screen: Inside Dhar Mann's Creative Process

Few creators are as prolific as Dhar Mann. In his 125,000-square-foot studio, he has over 65 sets and 10 crews filming at once to post five TV-length videos per week. It's a scaled machine unlike any other on YouTube, dedicated to uplifting the world by creating stories and experiences that help people feel seen and connected. In this session, Dhar breaks down how he went from filming videos in a studio apartment to building his own studio — and exactly how he takes a video from script to screen.

Dude Perfect | How to Build Your "Perfect" Team: 17 Years, 62M Subs, Same Dudes

Whether it's your next collab or co-founder you'll create with, finding the right people is everything. Dude Perfect knows that better than anyone. After 17 years, they're still growing — 62 million subscribers, $100M investment, and an 80,000 square foot HQ. Join the Dudes — Cory Cotton and Garrett Hilbert as they break down their biggest moments, most crucial decisions, and how they split up roles to build one of YouTube's biggest channels—and companies.

Jared Bush | Storytelling Spontaneity: When to Throw Out Good Ideas for Great Ones

Chief Creative Officer for Walt Disney Animation Studios Jared Bush has written or directed many beloved blockbusters, including Moana, Encanto, Zootopia, and more. He'll break down his storytelling process, what actually happens behind the scenes, and how to pursue great ideas.

Jordan Matter | Winning IRL: Why 87,000 Fans Came to Our Event

Jordan didn't get to 37 million subscribers by posting more. He posted differently. Together with his daughter Salish, they get 390 million longform views a month and brought 87,000 fans to their meetup — the biggest creator event in North American history. In this session, he walks through the rules and tips they follow to turn views into true fans and customers.

The Try Guys | How to Make Shows, Not Just Videos

Most creators just make videos But the Try Guys make great shows: Eat the Menu, Without a Recipe, Killer Dinner and more. With over 5 billion views and 12 years of experience, Zach and Keith break down their creative process step-by-step so any creator can apply to their content.

About Created in LA

Created in LA is an exclusive two-day experience created by Jon Youshaei and presented by Disney that brings together some of the world's top creators for a first-of-its kind program exploring the future of content, influence and storytelling. For more information visit [insert TWDC blog post link] and https://created.la/

About The Walt Disney Company 

The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international entertainment and media enterprise that includes three business segments: Entertainment, Sports, and Experiences. Disney is a Dow 30 company and had annual revenue of $94.4 billion in its Fiscal Year 2025.

releases.title: Industry Veteran Jeff Cave Joins OneAscent as Senior Vice President of Strategic Partnerships
releases.body:
Veteran wealth management leader will help advisors and firms design their preferred future through values-aligned guidance.

BIRMINGHAM, Ala., Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- OneAscent, a family of Kingdom-minded companies delivering values-aligned financial solutions to advisors and investors, today announced that Jeff Cave has joined the firm as Senior Vice President of Strategic Partnerships. 

In this newly created role, Cave will work alongside financial advisors and firms across the country to help them move into their "Preferred Future" by evaluating their businesses, identifying growth opportunities, and exploring how OneAscent's platform and business model can support their next stage of impact. Drawing on more than two decades of experience in wealth management, he will serve as a trusted partner to advisors considering affiliation, succession, independence, or strategic growth. 

Cave's approach begins with understanding each advisor's business and priorities, including where the practice is today, what matters most, and where the advisor wants to go next. That discovery is the foundation for designing their Preferred Future, and from there Cave helps advisors and firms see how OneAscent's platform, guidance, and values-aligned investment solutions can support their growth and long-term impact. 

"I've spent my career helping advisors build stronger businesses and better serve their clients," said Cave. "The wealth management industry is changing rapidly, and advisors have more choices than ever before. My goal is to help them step back, evaluate where they are today, and intentionally design where they want to go next."

Cave brings more than 25 years of leadership experience in the wealth and asset management industry. Most recently, Cave served in several roles at Eventide Asset Management, helping the firm grow distribution and assets.  Before Eventide, Mr. Cave spent over 20 years at Merrill Lynch, most recently as Director, Ultra High Net Worth Wealth Management Specialist for the Private Banking & Investment Group in New York City. He also served in SMA operations, marketing, and advisor training, helping to grow some of the industry`s most successful advisory fee-based platforms. He is also widely recognized for founding and leading the Christian Focus Group at Merrill Lynch, a nationwide network of over 1,600 advisors who seek to integrate Christian principles of finance with clients. 

Mr. Cave holds the Certified Investment Management Analyst (CIMA®) certification, administered by the Investment Management Consultants Association and taught in conjunction with the Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania. He is a Certified Kingdom Advisor (CKA®) and a member of the Board of Directors for Kingdom Advisors - an organization founded by Ron Blue and Larry Burkett. He also served on the Board of Managers for the Ron Blue Institute for Financial Planning. 

"We're excited to welcome Jeff to the OneAscent team," said Rob Grubb, Chief Operating Officer at OneAscent. "His credibility, experience, and genuine passion for serving advisors make him uniquely qualified to help firms navigate today's increasingly complex landscape. Jeff's approach is centered on relationships, wisdom, and long-term impact, qualities that align perfectly with OneAscent's mission of empowering advisors to advance the Kingdom." 

"Every advisor has a preferred future," Cave added. "My passion is helping them discover it, then equipping them with the relationships, resources, and investment solutions to serve clients with excellence and make a greater impact." 

Jeff holds an MBA from the University of Minnesota and a BBA from Loyola University. Jeff and his wife live in Pennsylvania.

About OneAscent 

OneAscent is a family of Kingdom-minded companies delivering values-aligned financial solutions to advisors and investors. Guided by a mission of empowering advisors to advance the Kingdom, the firm integrates guidance, investments, and giving through financial planning, wealth management, values-aligned public and private market strategies, retirement solutions, and comprehensive resources for advisors and the families they serve. 

Headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama, OneAscent supports 89 advisors across 41 firms, serving stewards in 49 states and provinces with more than $7.1 billion in assets under management dedicated to building legacies and the Kingdom. Learn more at oneascent.com.

releases.title: GRAIL Announces Inducement Grants Under NASDAQ Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
releases.body:
SUNNYVALE, Calif., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- GRAIL, Inc. (Nasdaq: GRAL), a healthcare company whose mission is to detect cancer early when it can be cured, today announced that it has granted equity awards in the form of restricted stock units ("RSUs") underlying an aggregate of 55,867 shares of GRAIL's common stock to 59 recently hired non-executive employees as an inducement material to their acceptance of employment with GRAIL. The employment inducement awards were granted under GRAIL's Inducement Equity Incentive Plan and related form of restricted stock award agreement in accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4).

The inducement plan is used exclusively for the grant of equity awards to individuals who were not previously employees of GRAIL, or following a bona fide period of non-employment, as an inducement material to such individuals entering into employment with GRAIL, pursuant to Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4).

The RSUs vest over an approximately four year period, with 25% of the award vesting Aug. 31, 2027, and on each one year anniversary of those respective dates thereafter, subject to continued employment with GRAIL (or any successor to or subsidiary of the Company) through the vesting dates.

About GRAIL

GRAIL is a healthcare company whose mission is to detect cancer early, when it can be cured. GRAIL is focused on alleviating the global burden of cancer by using the power of next-generation sequencing, population-scale clinical studies, and state-of-the-art machine learning, software, and automation to detect and identify multiple deadly cancer types in earlier stages. GRAIL's targeted methylation-based platform can support the continuum of care for screening and precision oncology, including multi-cancer early detection in symptomatic patients, risk stratification, minimal residual disease detection, biomarker subtyping, treatment and recurrence monitoring. GRAIL is headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA with locations in Washington, D.C., North Carolina, and the United Kingdom.

releases.title: Ports of Indiana CEO Jody Peacock receives inaugural CARGO award from Inland Rivers, Ports and Terminals
releases.body:
KANSAS CITY, Mo., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Jody Peacock, CEO of Ports of Indiana, has been named one of the inaugural recipients of the CARGO Award, presented by Inland Rivers, Ports, and Terminals (IRPT) at its annual conference on Sept. 3.

IRPT is a nationwide, non-profit trade association founded in 1974 that represents and advocates for the United States inland waterway transportation system. The "CARGO" Award stands for Commitment to Advancing River Growth and Operations. IRPT created the award to recognize individuals whose careers reflect more than professional success — people who have helped move the inland waterways industry forward.

"We looked for people who have helped move this industry forward, and Jody Peacock has spent more than two decades doing exactly that," said Aimee Andres, executive director of Inland Rivers, Ports, and Terminals, in presenting the award. "He has helped grow ports, create opportunities for businesses and communities, and strengthened the connections between maritime transportation and economic development. It's my honor to recognize Jody and all the work he's done for our industry."

Jody has spent more than 25 years in the maritime industry, joining Ports of Indiana in 2001 and serving as CEO for the last three years. During his career, Jody has led transformation and growth initiatives throughout Indiana's three-port system and the maritime industry. He serves on numerous maritime and economic development boards supporting the growth of the nation's inland waterways and is a past recipient of the Distinguished Hoosier Award and the Sagamore of the Wabash, Indiana's highest civilian honor. Jody has been a driving force behind multiple regional cargo development strategies as well as the creation of Indiana's northern and southern port districts, which now rank as the #1 inland port in the country and the #2 Great Lakes port.

Jody was named CEO of Ports of Indiana in 2023, taking responsibility for a statewide port system that includes three ports on the Ohio River and Lake Michigan, 2,800 acres of multimodal industrial parks, three shortline railroads, and a statewide network of foreign-trade zones. Under his leadership, Ports of Indiana has achieved three consecutive years of unprecedented growth, secured the two largest federal grants in the organization's history, and opened its first new dock in two decades. The organization also established the largest general cargo operation on the Ohio River, started development of the state's first ocean container terminal, opened its first foreign office in Europe, and signed new partnership agreements with three international ports.

"Being recognized by the Inland Rivers, Ports, and Terminals is a tremendous honor, and to be an inaugural recipient of the CARGO Award means a great deal to me," said Jody Peacock, CEO of Ports of Indiana. "Over the past few decades, I've come to believe that ports are more than places where cargo changes hands — they're engines for economic growth and gateways to the world. I'm honored to be part of IRPT, which has become such a dynamic and important organization, and to share the vision that our waterways offer tremendous opportunity, strategic advantages, and public benefits for our nation."

Throughout his career, Jody has helped develop the strategies and business initiatives that transformed Ports of Indiana from a government-funded agency into the self-funded, entrepreneurial organization it is today, contributing $8.7 billion annually to the state economy and supporting 50,000 jobs throughout the region.

Earlier this year, Jody was elected to IRPT's Board of Directors as a Great Lakes Basin director, helping to strengthen representation of the organization's Great Lakes members and better connect the Great Lakes and inland river systems.

About Inland Rivers, Ports and Terminals: Inland Rivers, Ports and Terminals is a membership driven, nationwide trade association with a mission of being a resource for the inland river ports and promoting the healthy growth and operation of the industry. It was chartered as a non-profit corporation in 1974 under the laws of the State of Missouri. Visit https://www.irpt.net/ to learn more.

About Ports of Indiana: Ports of Indiana is a statewide port authority operating three ports on the Ohio River and Lake Michigan. Established in 1961, Ports of Indiana is a self-funded enterprise dedicated to growing Indiana's economy by developing and maintaining a world-class port system, and by serving as a statewide resource for maritime issues, international trade, and multimodal logistics. For more information, visit www.portsofindiana.com.

releases.title: Mid Island Y JCC Announces Historic Naming Gift from Dr. Harvey Manes and the Manes Peace Prize Foundation; Agency to Become Manes JCC
releases.body:
PLAINVIEW, N.Y., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Mid Island Y JCC, Long Island's leading Jewish community center announced last night that it received a transformative naming gift from longtime member Dr. Harvey Manes and the Manes Peace Prize Foundation. In recognition of the gift, the agency will officially be renamed Manes JCC.

The announcement was made Wednesday evening during a community-wide celebration at the agency's Plainview location, drawing members, neighbors, and supporters from across Long Island. The event featured remarks from Mid Island Y JCC CEO Rick Lewis, board leadership, and Dr. Manes, along with the unveiling of the agency's new name.

"Philanthropy is not an add-on to what we do at Mid Island Y JCC; it is the reason our programs, spaces, and services exist today," said Rick Lewis, CEO of the agency soon to be known as Manes JCC. "We have grown and flourished for 70 years because people who believe in this community have chosen to invest in it. This gift from Dr. Harvey Manes and the Manes Peace Prize Foundation is the newest, and one of the most significant chapters in that story."

Dr. Manes is an orthopedic surgeon, attorney, author, and philanthropist. A longtime member of Mid Island Y JCC, his relationship with the agency began in an exercise class and deepened over time. He previously supported the naming of the agency's Arts and Culture Center, and that growing commitment has now culminated in this landmark gift from Dr. Manes and the Manes Peace Prize Foundation, which he oversees with his children.

"This organization has given so much to this community for so long, and I have felt that impact firsthand," said Dr. Manes. "The Manes Peace Prize Foundation and I are proud to be part of the next chapter of this agency, and we hope this gift will help it do even more for the people for our community and those who need it most."

The gift will fund a combination of immediate capital improvements and longer-term investments in the agency's facilities and programs. Three projects are already underway: resealing and restriping the parking lot ahead of members' return in September, installing a new floor in the group fitness studio, and replacing fitness center equipment that has been in place since the facility's 2012 renovation.

"These three projects are just the beginning," said Vicki Diamond, President of the Manes JCC Board of Directors. "In the coming weeks and months, our board and leadership will determine how the remainder of this extraordinary gift will be put to work, and we cannot wait to share those plans with our community as they take shape."

Agency leaders regard the gift as transformative while recognizing the ongoing generosity that has always sustained the organization.

"We are beyond grateful to Dr. Harvey Manes and the Manes Peace Prize Foundation," Diamond added. "This gift is not a finish line. It is fuel for a community that has always shown up for itself and one that we are counting on to continue showing up."

The name change represents an investment in the organization's future, not a change to its mission. Manes JCC will continue to operate as a Jewish Community Center serving individuals and families of every age, background, and faith. Its programs and services span early childhood education and daycare, camp, school-age enrichment, fitness and aquatics, adult and senior services, memory care, special needs programming, and community-wide events.

About Manes JCC

Formerly known as Mid Island Y JCC, Manes JCC is a nonprofit Jewish Community Center whose programs, services, partnerships, and community impact reach individuals and families throughout Long Island. For 70 years, the agency has provided programs and services spanning early childhood education, camp, school-age enrichment, fitness and aquatics, adult and senior services, memory care, special needs programming, and community-wide events. Manes JCC welcomes members and neighbors of all ages, backgrounds, and faiths.

For more information, visit miyjcc.org.

LUFKIN, Texas, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- How does hospice care in Lufkin, Texas, support families beyond direct patient care? HelloNation has published an article that answers this question, featuring insights from Hospice Expert Demetress Harrell of Lufkin, Texas.

The HelloNation article explains that hospice care in Lufkin is structured to assist both patients and their loved ones. Families often face emotional strain, physical fatigue, and the daily demands of caregiving. Hospice services are designed to ease these pressures by providing skilled nursing, in-home aides, and clear guidance throughout the process.

According to the article, caregiver support is a central part of family-focused hospice. Nurses and personal care aides help with bathing, mobility, and symptom monitoring, which allows relatives to spend more quality time together. Hospice teams also provide training and education, so family members feel prepared to manage daily routines safely.

Respite care is highlighted as another important feature of hospice services in Lufkin. The article describes how temporary relief gives caregivers time to rest, attend appointments, or manage personal responsibilities. This planned break helps reduce burnout while ensuring the patient continues to receive consistent care.

Emotional support is another key component of hospice care in Lufkin. Social workers and counselors help families work through anxiety, anticipatory grief, and exhaustion. The article notes that grief support services in Lufkin begin before a loss and continue afterward, offering structured guidance during each stage of adjustment.

Bereavement programs are also discussed as part of a complete family-focused hospice approach. These programs may include counseling, support groups, and connections to community resources. Continued emotional support helps families build resilience and navigate life after hospice care.

The article emphasizes that hospice care in Angelina County addresses practical needs as well as emotional concerns. Hospice teams coordinate medical equipment, review daily routines, and help create a safe home setting. By managing logistics and care planning, hospice services provide stability during a challenging time.

Financial guidance is another area covered in the piece. The HelloNation article explains that the Medicare hospice benefit in Texas typically covers skilled nursing care, medications related to the illness, and necessary medical equipment. Hospice teams assist families in understanding the Medicare hospice benefit, completing paperwork, and clarifying coverage details.

Education and open communication are presented as essential elements of hospice care in Lufkin. Families are encouraged to ask questions and participate in shared decision-making. Clear explanations about symptom management and available hospice services help families feel informed and involved.

Spiritual guidance is also included within this family-focused hospice model. Chaplains or spiritual counselors provide support that respects individual beliefs and traditions. This care complements medical treatment and emotional support, creating a well-rounded system of care.

Throughout the article, readers learn that hospice care in Lufkin combines hospice pain management, caregiver support, grief support services, bereavement programs, and guidance about the Medicare hospice benefit into one coordinated approach. By integrating medical, emotional, and spiritual resources, hospice services help families focus on connection, comfort, and meaningful time together.

How Hospice Care Supports Families in Lufkin Beyond the Patient features insights from Demetress Harrell, Hospice Expert in Lufkin, Texas, in HelloNation.

releases.title: Hims & Hers Health (NYSE: HIMS) Faces Securities Class Action After FTC Lawsuit Reveal Drives Stock Sharply Lower -- HBSS
releases.body:
SAN FRANCISCO, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Hims & Hers Health, Inc. (NYSE: HIMS) and certain company executives now face a securities class action lawsuit stemming from the FTC's sweeping federal complaint against the company in which the Commission accuses Hims of serious business misconduct.

Hagens Berman, which is actively investigating the alleged claims, encourages HIMS investors who suffered substantial losses to submit your losses now.

Class Period: Aug. 4, 2025 – July 29, 2026

Lead Plaintiff Deadline: Nov. 2, 2026

Visit Hims Investigation Page: www.hbsslaw.com/hims

Direct Contact Email: HIMS@hbsslaw.com

Firm Telephone: 844-916-0895

Hims & Hers Health ($HIMS) Securities Class Action

The lawsuit is focused on the propriety of Hims' repeated assurances that "[w]e have developed and maintain policies and procedures with respect to health information and personal information that we use or disclose in connection with our operations, including the adoption of administrative, physical, and technical safeguards to protect such information."

The complaint alleges that Hims: (1) shared consumers' health information with third-party advertising platforms; (2) charges consumers for prescriptions almost immediately after they submit intake forms, despite telling them that they will be able to consult with a medical provider to find a treatment that is "right for them[;]" and (3) as a result, would be subject to heightened regulatory scrutiny and likely to incur fees and penalties.

What Drove the $HIMS July 29, 2026 Stock Crash? The FTC and State Lawsuit Breakdown

The securities class action cites the July 29, 2026 federal complaint filed against Hims by the FTC—alongside co-plaintiffs the State of Utah and the County of Los Angeles (representing California).

After an extensive investigation by the Commission, it contends that Hims engaged in:

  1. Deceptive Health Data Sharing: Despite extensive marketing campaigns emphasizing strict privacy, discreet telehealth consultations, and data protection, the complaint alleges that Hims surreptitiously shared sensitive user medical conditions and personal health data with third-party advertising giants, including Meta Platforms (Facebook) and Snap, via embedded tracking pixels and customer list matching.
  2. Subscription Billing & Cancellation Barriers (ROSCA Violations): The lawsuit accuses Hims of violating the Restore Online Shoppers' Confidence Act (ROSCA) by enrolling consumers in recurring subscription models without informed consent. According to regulators, consumers were billed for prescriptions almost immediately upon completing an intake form—long before receiving any consultation with a medical provider—while facing dark patterns and hidden cancellation options designed to prevent subscription termination.

The market swiftly reacted, sending the price of Hims shares down $4.32 (-14.7%) and erasing over $970 million from the company's market capitalization in a single day.

"We're focused on whether Hims may have intentionally misled investors about its business practices, including the adequacy of its internal controls, and financial ramifications of the alleged misconduct," said Reed Kathrein, the Hagens Berman partner leading the firm's investigation.

If you invested in HIMS and have substantial losses, or have knowledge that will assist the firm's investigation, submit your losses now »

Whistleblowers: Persons with non-public information regarding HIMS should consider their options to help in the investigation or take advantage of the SEC Whistleblower program. Under the new program, whistleblowers who provide original information may receive rewards totaling up to 30 percent of any successful recovery made by the SEC. For more information, call Reed Kathrein at 844-916-0895 or email HIMS@hbsslaw.com.

Hagens Berman is a global plaintiffs' rights complex litigation firm focusing on corporate accountability. The firm is home to a robust practice and represents investors as well as whistleblowers, workers, consumers and others in cases achieving real results for those harmed by corporate negligence and other wrongdoings. Hagens Berman's team has secured more than $2.9 billion in this area of law. More about the firm and its successes can be found at hbsslaw.com. Follow the firm for updates and news at @ClassActionLaw.

releases.title: Unifor celebrates Made-in-Canada manufacturing of VIA Rail passenger cars
releases.body:
THUNDER BAY, ON, Sept. 3, 2026 /CNW/ -- Unifor applauds today's federal government announcement that Alstom has been awarded a $4.7 billion contract to build 313 passenger cars for VIA Rail, securing significant work for Unifor Local 1075 members at the company's Thunder Bay facility.

"This is a tremendous victory for our members in Thunder Bay and for Canadian manufacturing. It's also an important investment in public passenger rail, securing an important service for Canadians – a service proudly provided at VIA by Unifor members across the country," said Unifor National President Lana Payne.

"Our members at Thunder Bay have the skills and experience to build world-class passenger railcars right here in Canada. This contract recognizes their expertise and ensures that Canadian public procurement dollars support Canadian workers, families, and communities. It took a trade war to get us here, but let's keep building Canada by Canadians and for Canadians."

The contract means for the first time in four decades, VIA Rail passenger cars will be built in Canada, as part of VIA Rail's renewal of its long-distance, regional, and remote passenger fleet.

The cars will be manufactured and assembled in Alstom's Thunder Bay plant and La Pocatière, Que., with design and engineering work taking place in Saint-Bruno-de-Montarville, Que.

"At a time when workers and industries are facing unprecedented economic threats from the United States, governments must use every tool available to strengthen our domestic manufacturing capacity," said Unifor Quebec Director Daniel Cloutier.

Work at the Thunder Bay facility is expected to create approximately 700 jobs in Quebec and Ontario and generate more than $1.6 billion in economic benefits.

Unifor has advocated strongly for the VIA Rail procurement to include Canadian content and create work in Canada. In March, the union wrote to Prime Minister Mark Carney urging the federal government not to allow the generational investment in Canada's passenger rail system to bypass Canadian workers.

"'Made-in-Canada' can't just be a slogan. It must mean awarding publicly funded work to facilities right here at home and creating good union jobs in Canada," said Unifor Ontario Regional Director Samia Hashi.

"Our members are proud of what they build, and they have proven they have the experience to deliver high-quality rail vehicles for Canadians.

Alstom announced it will invest $38 million in upgrades to the Thunder Bay plant.

The Alstom plant in Thunder Bay has historically played a central role in Canada's rail manufacturing industry. Unifor Local 1075 members at the facility have built and refurbished passenger rail and public transit vehicles for communities across the country.

Unifor represents approximately 5,500 members who build and maintain buses and rail vehicles at five manufacturing facilities across Canada, including facilities in Thunder Bay and Winnipeg and in Sainte-Claire and Saint-Eustache, Que.

Unifor is Canada's largest union in the private sector, representing 320,000 workers in every major area of the economy. The union advocates for all working people and their rights, fights for equality and social justice in Canada and abroad, and strives to create progressive change for a better future.
